gates.name: word_count
gates.detail: 210 spoken words; need 180-225. Add about 8 words.

gates.name: hook_trigger
gates.detail: hook needs a number, a 'you', a named thing, or a contradiction in the first line.

gates.name: hook_text
gates.detail: on-screen hook 'HALF A BRAND, $300 MILLION' should be 2-7 words.

gates.name: complete_ending
gates.detail: end on a complete sentence (no trailing off with '...'): the viewer must hear the whole thought.

gates.name: originality
gates.detail: too close to an earlier video (similarity 0.33); change the angle and hook.

gates.name: voice_quality
gates.detail: reads like generic AI copy (compression classifier): swap filler for concrete numbers, names, and short spoken sentences; cut phrases like 'financial journey' and 'unlock'

gates.name: readability
gates.detail: average sentence is 10.5 words; aim for 8-14.

gates.name: judge_hook
gates.detail: hook scored 5/10. Rewrite Line 1 to cut weak opening words: Change 'Reportedly, Jay-Z sold half of one champagne brand...' to 'Jay-Z turned a champagne brand into $300 million in cash without selling all of it.'; Cut or bridge Line 9 (Tidal deal): Dropping a second company randomly at line 9 breaks focus—either remove Tidal entirely or use it as a 2-second fast frame: 'And it wasn't a fluke—days later he sold most of Tidal for $297 million.'; Tighten Lines 6-7: 'In 2021, he sold 50% to Moet Hennessy. The official price wasn't disclosed, but Forbes estimated the brand at $630 million.'
